t: 特鲁瓦-里维耶尔市成立于新法兰西(现加拿大魁北克).
te: The city of Trois-Rivières is founded in New France (now Quebec, Canada).

t: Urbain Grandier 神父因巫术被指控并被定罪，在法国卢登被活活烧死。
te: Father Urbain Grandier, accused and convicted of sorcery, is burned alive in Loudun, France.
dz: Urbain Grandier 神父因巫术被指控并被定罪，在法国卢登被活活烧死。

t: 在诺德林根战役中，天主教帝国军队击败了瑞典和德国新教军队。
te: In the Battle of Nördlingen, the Catholic Imperial army defeats Swedish and German Protestant forces.
dz: 三十年战争：在诺德林根战役中，天主教帝国军队击败了瑞典和德国新教军队。
de: Thirty Years' War: In the Battle of Nördlingen, the Catholic Imperial army defeats Swedish and German Protestant forces.

t: 一家火药厂在马耳他瓦莱塔爆炸,造成22人死亡并损坏多所建筑.
te: A gunpowder factory explodes in Valletta, Malta, killing 22 people and damaging several buildings.
dz: 一家火药厂在马耳他瓦莱塔爆炸,造成22人死亡并损坏多所建筑.

te: The Burchardi flood kills around 15,000 in North Friesland, Denmark and Germany.
dz: Burchardi洪水在北弗里斯兰,丹麦和德国造成约15,000人死亡.
de: The Burchardi flood kills around 15,000 in North Friesland, Denmark and Germany.
